name: Genetic Neurodegenerative Disease with Dementia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Genetic Neurodegenerative Dementia

criteria.description: Positive family history of neurodegenerative dementia with autosomal dominant inheritance pattern
Progressive cognitive decline consistent with dementia syndrome over at least 6 months
Identification of pathogenic mutation in a known neurodegeneration-associated gene
Exclusion of secondary causes of dementia such as metabolic, infectious, or toxic etiologies
Neuroimaging findings consistent with neurodegeneration (e.g., cortical atrophy, basal ganglia involvement)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive cognitive decline with positive family history and genetic confirmation of pathogenic mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of clinical, genetic, and imaging data; exclusion of other causes is essential.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Progressive memory impairment with early episodic memory loss

common.symptomName: Executive dysfunction with impaired planning and judgment
Behavioral changes including apathy and disinhibition
Motor symptoms including rigidity and bradykinesia

occasional.symptomName: Psychotic features such as hallucinations or delusions
searchTerms: seeing or hearing things not real

occasional.symptomName: Sleep disturbances including REM sleep behavior disorder
searchTerms: sleep problems including acting out dreams

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests excluding metabolic causes
CSF biomarkers may show elevated tau or decreased beta-amyloid
imaging: MRI showing cortical and hippocampal atrophy
FDG-PET demonstrating hypometabolism in temporal and parietal lobes
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in genes such as PSEN1, PSEN2, APP, or MAPT
other: Neuropsychological testing confirming deficits in memory, executive function, and language

distinguishingFeatures: Sporadic onset without clear family history
Absence of known pathogenic genetic mutation
Frontal and temporal lobe atrophy predominant on imaging

redFlags: Rapidly progressive dementia over weeks to months
Early onset dementia with positive family history
Presence of motor neuron disease signs
references: Orphanet: Genetic Neurodegenerative Disease with Dementia - ORPHA:276058
Mendez MF. The accurate diagnosis of early-onset dementia. Int J Psychiatry Med. 2017.
Rascovsky K, et al. Sensitivity of revised diagnostic criteria for the behavioural variant of frontotemporal dementia. Brain. 2011.
